# PR Checklist

## Summary
- What does this change do?
- Why is it needed?

## Checks
- [ ] Build runs locally (if applicable)
- [ ] Lint/format (if applicable)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Docs updated (if applicable)

## Risk
- [ ] Low-risk change
- [ ] Medium-risk change
- [ ] High-risk change (include mitigation plan)

## Screenshots / Evidence
- [ ] Attached (if UI change)
